text: Which genes of the neuron synaptic function brain cluster are expressed in every brain region and not enhanced in astrocytes (single-cell)?
plan: Brain expression cluster (RNA): 14:Neurons - Synaptic function AND Brain region category (RNA): any / Detected in all AND NOT Cell type category (scRNA): Astrocytes / Cell type enhanced
understanding: The question asks for genes belonging to the co-expression cluster for brain synaptic function ('neuron synaptic function brain cluster'), that are detected/expressed across all brain regions, and are not categorized as enhanced in astrocytes based on single-cell RNA profiling.

trail.why: The cluster specified by the requirement 'neuron synaptic function' corresponds directly to '14:Neurons - Synaptic function'.
The category 'Detected in all' defines genes detected at or above the threshold in every brain region of the dataset, while leaving level 1 unrestricted covers all regions.
Specifies 'Astrocytes' at Level 1 and 'Cell type enhanced' at Level 2 to match genes enhanced in astrocytes, which the query requires to exclude.

requirements.why: It defines co-expression clusters across brain regions named by function and region, covering brain clusters like neuron synaptic function.
It classifies human RNA distribution and specificity across brain regions, including categories for genes detected/expressed in all brain regions.

I chose Cell type category (scRNA) over Brain region cell type (scRNA) because 'Astrocytes' is an explicit option matching single-cell cell types across tissues/single-cell RNA-seq, and negated it using NOT to exclude genes enhanced in astrocytes.
